name: Urgent Care – Penn Yan
address: 418 North Main Street, 2nd Floor, Penn Yan, NY 14527
hoursNote: Open Monday–Saturday 8 a.m.–8 p.m.; closed Sunday. Walk-ins welcome; call ahead or book online at flhealth.org to reduce wait time. For emergencies, use the Soldiers & Sailors Memorial Hospital ER (24/7, same building, ground floor).
description: Walk-in urgent care on the second floor of Soldiers & Sailors Memorial Hospital, operated by UR Medicine Finger Lakes Health. Opened February 2025. Treats minor injuries and illnesses including sprains, ear infections, and colds; rapid PCR COVID/flu/strep testing with 30-minute results, plus imaging and lab services on-site.
